worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.summar: Tell a joke that interrupts and pins nearby foes, makes them lose their target, and leaves a lingering snowfield where you stood while you slip away; with a reserve it swaps straight to it.
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.use.1: Interrupt and pin several nearby foes at once
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.use.2: Leave snow behind while bowing out
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.descri: The hush covers a radius of %1$s blocks: foes inside are interrupted at once, lose their current target, and are rooted in place for %2$s (unable to move); the cold mark lingers on them about %3$s.
The joke leaves a radius-%1$s snowfield where it was told, lasting %2$s; the area counts as snowing and anything inside is marked as standing in snowfall.
Retreats %1$s blocks away from the nearest enemy; with no enemy nearby it stays put.
Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.timing: Centred on yourself (range %1$s blocks); after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to tell the joke, recovers %3$s, and cools down %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.growth: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.prefer: On = heavy punchline: wider hush (x1.25), longer root (x1.3), longer chill (x1.3) and denser snow (x1.3), but shorter snow (x0.8) and cooldown +18 ticks. Off = understated: smaller and shorter hush, but the snow lasts longer (x1.2) and cools down 12 ticks sooner.
The companion only tells the joke while a threat is within this distance; lower tells it up close, higher clears the room in advance.
Below this health ratio the companion prioritizes the joke to get out; higher leaves earlier, lower stays and fights longer.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to tell the joke.
